math_notes.text: Defines multistrates as strictly irreducible objects of the inclusion poset, strata of a figure, its stratum set, and lieux via minimality for the second relation. At1 gives nonemptiness and bounded suprema, and At2 expresses a figure as the supremum of its strata.

The displayed At2 margin criterion with F and G follows from At2: if F≤G, every X≤F is also a stratum of G, so choose Y=X. Conversely, if every stratum X of F lies below a stratum Y of G, each X≤G; taking the supremum of all such X gives F≤G. This validates the displayed F/G criterion conditionally on At2; it does not decide the initial C|G glyph.

Under clause b, a nonempty family contains the empty set: take one member Phi and use the empty closed subset of Phi. The converse is immediate. Under the union=M clause, M nonempty forces the family nonempty. These are the two implications stated in the c margin. The proof is about the clauses as read, not evidence for their individual glyphs.

The literal script F(M), the overbar inside b′, the C in F∨C, and the missing second X in the first compatibility line are preserved. Each was compared with nearby forms rather than repaired to an expected notation.

The complete Scholie equivalence and the reconstruction of a finite-type figure poset from its multistrata, order and compatibility relation were read but not independently proved; At3 is not on this page.
